lesson.title: the three names you say in one breath
lesson.hook: Father, Son and Holy Spirit: said at every baptism, rarely explained

title: three names, one breath
hook: you've said it your whole life. now explain it.
cast: shot 5: Tertullian as a North African man in Carthage; today: Korean-American family in Los Angeles, grandparents and a baby.
